integrity: Analytical proof is self-contained; finite numerical checks supplement but do not replace it. Results are same-model reviewed, with no independent audit or certification.
scientific_limitations: Only two outcome rows on exactly three distinct spatial sites over prime fields p>=5; not an all-sparse-input reconstruction theorem, not restricted to different bases, and no prime-power generalization. Bibliographic priority risk for three-root phasor optimization.
title: Universal sharp conditioning of two quadratic-chirp rows on any prime-field three-site aperture
